products.product: Works Chassis Lab Kawasaki Engine Mounts (front engine brackets and top engine hangers)
products.variants: Front brackets Soft or Stiff; top hangers Soft, Medium or Stiff; sold individually or combined
products.what_it_changes: Tester (DirtBikeTest): soft bracket + soft hangers absorbed bumps well but felt vague in corners and lost drive traction; soft bracket + stiff hangers gave a more connected rear; stiff bracket + stiff hangers felt precise and still more compliant than stock.
